shortDescription: Manage vNIC Templates for Cisco Intersight

options.name: api_bearer_token
options.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication with the Intersight API. When provided, I(api_key_id) and I(api_private_key) are not required and the C(cryptography) Python library is not needed. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable is used.

options.name: api_key_id
options.description: Public API Key ID associated with the private key. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_KEY_ID environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_private_key
options.description: Filename (absolute path) or string of PEM formatted private key data to be used for Intersight API authentication. If a string is used, Ansible vault should be used to encrypt string data. Ex. ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id tme@/Users/dsoper/Documents/vault_password_file '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----     <your private key data>     -----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----' If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not

options.name: api_uri
options.description: URI used to access the Intersight API. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_URI environment variable is used.

options.name: cdn_source
options.description: Source of the CDN. It can either be user specified or be the same as the vNIC name.

options.name: cdn_value
options.description: CDN value when cdn_source is 'user'.

options.name: connection_type
options.description: Type of connection for the vNIC.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description for the vNIC Template. Description can contain letters(a-z, A-Z), numbers(0-9), hyphen(-), period(.), colon(:), or an underscore(_).

options.name: enable_override
options.description: When enabled, the configuration of the derived instances may override the template configuration.

options.name: eth_adapter_policy_name
options.description: Relationship to the Ethernet Adapter Policy. Required when state is 'present'.

options.name: eth_qos_policy_name
options.description: Relationship to the Ethernet QoS Policy. Required when state is 'present'.

options.name: fabric_eth_network_control_policy_name
options.displayName: Fabric Eth Network Control Policy Name
options.description: Relationship to the Fabric Ethernet Network Control Policy. Required when state is 'present'.

options.name: fabric_eth_network_group_policy_name
options.displayName: Fabric Eth Network Group Policy Name
options.description: Relationship to the Fabric Ethernet Group Policy. Required when state is 'present'.

options.name: failover_enabled
options.description: Enables automatic vNIC failover to the secondary Fabric Interconnect if the primary path fails. Failover applies only to Cisco VICs that are connected to a Fabric Interconnect cluster.

options.name: iscsi_boot_policy_name
options.description: Relationship to the boot iSCSI Policy.

options.name: mac_pool_name
options.description: The MAC pool that is assigned to the vNIC Template. Required when state is 'present'.

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the vNIC Template. Must be unique within the organization. The name must be between 1 and 64 alphanumeric characters, allowing special characters :-_.

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the Organization this resource is assigned to. Policies created within a Custom Organization are applicable only to devices in the same Organization. Use 'default' for the default organization.

options.name: pin_group_name
options.description: Pingroup name associated to vNIC for static pinning. LCP deploy will resolve pingroup name and fetches the corresponding uplink port/port channel to pin the vNIC traffic.

options.name: sriov_settings
options.description: SR-IOV settings when connection_type is 'sriov'.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify the resource is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify the resource is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: switch_id
options.description: The fabric port to which the vNIC will be associated.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags in Key:<user-defined key> Value:<user-defined value> format.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: usnic_settings
options.description: USNIC settings when connection_type is 'usnic'. Required when connection_type is 'usnic'.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean control for verifying the api_uri TLS certificate

options.name: vmq_settings
options.description: VMQ settings when connection_type is 'vmq'.
